body.explanation: lc is saturated, and the scheduler gives fa the normalized part p/(p+0.5) and fb 0.5/(p+0.5), using work-conserving unused capacity when fb is not backlogged. fa_goodput_bps rises with p while fb_loss_frac rises once fb's weighted service falls below its 80 Mbps offer. lc.queue.length=1000 does not change steady-state delivered goodputs but lowers measured fb_loss_frac by leaving more packets queued at the measurement boundary. This makes p=0.185 L=1000 feasible, while p=0.186 L=1000 exceeds the loss limit. At this setting fa has enough backlog that fa.type does not change the goal metrics; TcpBbr gives the same measured fa_goodput_bps and fb_loss_frac as TcpCubic.
